name: SVRN, Inc. (formerly OceanPal Inc.)

profile.description: SVRN, Inc. (formerly OceanPal Inc., legal name change effective August 27, 2026) operates a dual business model: a legacy dry bulk shipping fleet and SovereignAI Services LLC, a digital asset treasury subsidiary holding approximately 55.5 million NEAR Protocol tokens. The company raised $120M through a PIPE to launch SovereignAI, which aims to build confidential AI cloud infrastructure. Changed ticker from OP to SVRN in November 2025. Executed a 1-for-20 reverse stock split in March 2026. Marshall Islands incorporated, Greek operated. Appointed G-20 Group to manage NEAR treasury yield strategy in 2026.

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (1/3): The company pivoted from a three-vessel dry bulk operator into a NEAR Protocol digital-asset treasury via SovereignAI Services LLC in October 2025, holding ~$77.5M of digital assets at year-end 2025 — a pivot in balance-sheet strategy rather than a proven product launch [1][2]. AI Deployment (1/2): SovereignAI's stated goal is to build blockchain-native, confidential AI-cloud infrastructure, but nothing is shipping; current income is NEAR staking rewards ($0.7M in its first two months) [1][3]. Market Share (0/2): Commodity participant in dry bulk and a small holder of NEAR tokens. Pipeline (0/2): No named products or timelines for the AI cloud. R&D (0/1): No R&D spending reported [5].

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (1/4): The stated aim to acquire 10% of NEAR supply and build 'confidential AI cloud' infrastructure is aspirational but generic crypto-treasury language without a purpose beyond asset accumulation [3]. Community Impact (0/2): No charitable programs found. Employee Retention (0/2): The Chief Corporate Development & Governance Officer resigned in March 2026, and Ernst & Young reportedly quit as auditor the day the treasury strategy debuted [3][4]. Insider Buying (0/2): No insider buying; instead short seller Fugazi alleges ~$10.5M cash and $4.5M stock went to sellers of control (Diana Shipping and Tuscany Shipping) [4].

infrastructure.label: DEVELOPING
infrastructure.analysis: Mechanically scored as a Growth stock on 7 of 10 weight units (forward P/E and PEG unavailable; no earnings estimates); weighted sum 2.79/7 = 3.98, rounded to 4. Zero debt scores D/E 1.0, and the 5-year revenue CAGR of 8.4% ($9.4M in 2020 to $14.1M in 2025, from a small predecessor base) scores 0.89 at 2x [5]. Everything else scores 0: FY2025 revenue fell 45% to $14.1M, the TTM net margin is -581% and TTM ROE is -46.5% on a $65.2M FY2025 net loss driven by NEAR mark-to-market losses [1][5]. Liquidity cleared: ~125K shares x $31.12 = ~$3.9M daily, though the price reflects a 1-for-20 reverse split in March 2026 [3].

ai_resilience.label: MODERATE
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (6/9): Neither dry bulk shipping (physical vessels, three ships, ~$6,400/day budgeted opex) nor holding NEAR tokens is displaced by AI, so direct substitution risk is low [1]. However, the equity story leans on the 'AI blockchain' narrative behind NEAR, so a cooling of AI-crypto sentiment hits the treasury's value directly. AI Opportunity (0/1): No AI revenue — income is charter hire and staking rewards; the confidential AI cloud is unbuilt [1][3].

infinite_game.summary: SVRN is a textbook finite player by Sinek's lens: four reverse splits since 2022 (cumulatively ~1-for-100,000), toxic warrant dilution, auditor and executive departures, and a pivot to a token treasury driven by survival rather than cause [3][4]. Nothing in its conduct suggests an organization built to endure.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (0/3): The company's purpose is to accumulate NEAR tokens; there is no articulated vision of a better future beyond asset growth [3].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): Ernst & Young reportedly resigned as auditor, the governance officer resigned in March 2026, and Fugazi alleges vessels were sold below carrying value to an affiliate of the former chairwoman — markers of a low-trust organization [3][4].

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): No evidence of competitive self-reflection; the company is a small price-taker in both markets.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): The shift from shipping to a NEAR digital-asset treasury and AI-cloud aspiration is dramatic, but Sinek's top score requires a pivot driven by a cause, not by a sub-$1 share price and delisting pressure [1][3].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): Decisions have repeatedly protected the listing at shareholder expense — a July 2025 offering whose cashless warrants grew the share count from ~18.6M to ~167.4M in three weeks with no cash received, followed by serial reverse splits to cure Nasdaq bid-price deficiencies [3][4].

investment_thesis: The bull case is a deep discount to stated book: SVRN's ~$58M market cap compares with $156.6M of year-end 2025 stockholders' equity, the company carries no debt, its three ships have no drydockings scheduled in 2026, and SovereignAI earns NEAR staking yield ($0.7M in its first two months) [1][5]. A sharp NEAR rally or progress on the confidential AI-cloud plan could re-rate the shares quickly.
thesis_continued: The bear case dominates: FY2025 revenue fell 45% to $14.1M with a $65.2M net loss, value hinges on a single volatile token, and short seller Fugazi calls the stock 'uninvestable,' alleging the $120M PIPE included only ~$13.7M of cash with the NEAR Foundation controlling ~71.6% on a fully exercised basis [1][4]. Serial reverse splits, Nasdaq delisting notices, auditor turnover and alleged related-party vessel sales signal severe governance risk [3][4].
key_catalysts: Sustained NEAR Protocol price appreciation lifting treasury NAV well above the market cap [2]
Delivery of a concrete product or customer for SovereignAI's confidential AI cloud
Resolution of Nasdaq listing compliance following the March 30, 2026 1-for-20 reverse split [3]
key_risks: Concentration in a single crypto token: NEAR price declines translate directly into mark-to-market losses (FY2025 net loss $65.2M) [1]
Further dilution from warrants and offerings — the company has executed four reverse splits since 2022 and saw share count jump ~9x in three weeks in 2025 [4]
Governance and control risk: alleged related-party vessel sales, auditor resignation, and potential NEAR Foundation control of ~71.6% fully exercised [4]
